name: @red-cup-engineering/npm-registry-audit-service
description: Runs the live-registry dependency audit: derives internal scopes from the Verdaccio config that is already the registry's own access-control authority, lists the live catalog, and gates on unresolved-dependency defects. Replaces the deleted root Makefile's registry-audit target, which hand-copied a scope list that drifted out of sync with config.yaml.
